tools.name: nearest_station
tools.description: FREE. Nearest Environment Canada climate station to a Canadian postal code, with the last 3 daily observations (max/min/precip).

tools.name: daily_history
tools.description: PRO. Up to 90 days of daily max/min/mean temperature and precipitation for a climate station id.

tools.name: compare_stations
tools.description: PRO. Last 7 days of observations for up to 5 climate stations (pass station ids from nearest_station).
